architecture_summary: Fine-tuned bert-base-uncased sequence classifier with WordPiece tokenization, 512-token truncation, and a two-class classification head.
label_orientation: The original notebook scores class index 1 as the positive class; the project convention is 1 = AI-generated.
training_data_requirements: Uses the original model trained on the original source dataset, not the repository's frozen partitions. The separate random split creates a risk of overlap with the repository's standard and unseen evaluation partitions; its scores must not be interpreted as leakage-free or directly compared with frozen-split models.
training_split_description: Original notebook uses stratified train_test_split with random_state=42: 132068 train, 16509 validation, and 16509 test records (80/10/10). The notebook loads the original CS747data.csv; dataset hash and overlap with the repository's frozen partitions are unknown.
cpu_compatibility: Yes; transformers BERT inference can run on CPU when a trusted checkpoint is present.
integration_status: Pinned Hugging Face checkpoint loads and runs inference on CPU; standardized evaluation is not claimed.
dataset_hash_method: SHA-256 of text,labels CSV serialization after dropping source, index excluded

recreated_original_split.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of comma-separated sorted zero-based original row indices

verified_inference.smoke_test: Loaded the pinned model and returned one finite probability for a single text.

redistribution_limitations: The Hugging Face model card declares license 'unknown'; check with the model owner before redistribution or reuse beyond this project.
known_limitations: The author's stratified 80/10/10 split is distinct from the repository split, so records may overlap with the repository's frozen standard or unseen evaluation sets. A split was recreated from the provided original dataset file, but identity with the exact training-time copy has not been independently verified. The Hugging Face model card has no detailed training documentation and declares license unknown.
provenance_notes: Training procedure and class-1 positive orientation were verified from the original notebook. The original 80/10/10 split was recreated from the user-provided dataset using random_state=42, and local dataset/split hashes are recorded. Whether that file is byte-identical to the training-time copy is unverified. The Hugging Face checkpoint is pinned to an immutable commit. This model does not comply with the frozen-split training requirement in models/model-prompt.md.
status_detail: Loaded the pinned public Hugging Face checkpoint and completed a CPU inference smoke test. Repository evaluation datasets are absent, and no standardized evaluation result is claimed.
